-- message --
cache: drop the lock, reads are hot
-- expect --
medium+
-- base/internal/cache/cache.go --
package cache

import "sync"

type Cache struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	m  map[string]string
}

func (c *Cache) Get(k string) (string, bool) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	v, ok := c.m[k]
	return v, ok
}

func (c *Cache) Set(k, v string) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.m[k] = v
}
-- head/internal/cache/cache.go --
package cache

type Cache struct {
	m map[string]string
}

func (c *Cache) Get(k string) (string, bool) {
	v, ok := c.m[k]
	return v, ok
}

func (c *Cache) Set(k, v string) {
	c.m[k] = v
}
